title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - ContainerResourceLimits
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/ContainerResourceLimits. InstantiationRequirements for containers (available resources and associated limits). Subclass of InstantiationRequirement per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the InstantiationRequirement model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ContainerResourceLimits'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

cpuRequirements.description: Relationship. CPU requirements. Links to a CPU entity.

numberOfCoresLimit.description: Property. Limit to the number of cores usable by a container (expressed in millicores).

memoryRequirements.description: Relationship. Container memory requirements. Links to a Memory entity.

memoryLimit.description: Relationship. Container memory limits. Links to a MemorySize entity.

gpuRequirements.description: Relationship. Number of GPUs required. Links to a GPU entity.

confidential.description: Property. Indicates whether the container is of confidential nature.

confidentialComputingTechnology.description: Relationship. Details with respect to confidential computing requirements. Links to a ConfidentialComputing entity.
